methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected directly from each vendor's official pricing page via live WebFetch on 2026-06-14 (accessedAt field) or from the vendor's official changelog/docs when the pricing page rendered JS-only. Render's pricing page returned JS-rendered content with no prices extractable; current prices were obtained from render.com/changelog (April 23, 2026 entry confirming Hobby free / Pro $25/month flat / Scale $499/month flat). Fly.io operates purely usage-metered with no flat tiers; the lowest published committed compute rate is recorded and unit rates are in notes. Quote-only and contact-sales tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd = null — no figures were guessed. Telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on every plan because this is a non-telephony vertical. Heroku has many dyno SKUs; only the primary Cedar platform dyno tiers are recorded to keep the dataset tractable. Railway's free Trial plan is one-time $5 credit (not a recurring plan) and is excluded; the Hobby and Pro recurring plans are recorded. Sevalla (formerly Kinsta App Hosting after redirect) is included as an additional vendor with clear published pricing.

vendors.name: Render
vendors.provenance: render.com/pricing returned JS-only content with no extractable prices. Current plan prices obtained from render.com/changelog (April 23, 2026 entry: Hobby free, Pro $25/month flat, Scale $499/month flat replacing per-seat model). HIPAA/BAA confirmed in same changelog entry for Scale and Enterprise tiers.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: Free workspace plan. 750 free instance hours/month for web services. Free Postgres (expires 30 days after creation, 1 GB). Free static sites. Services spin down after inactivity. Usage overages billed at standard compute rates.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat $25/month regardless of team size (unlimited members). Includes SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audit logs. Custom domains $0.25/month each over included allowance. Build pipeline overages $5 per 1,000 minutes. Bandwidth overages $0.15/GB (was $30/100 GB, reduced to $15/100 GB Aug 2025). No HIPAA on this tier.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Flat $499/month, unlimited team members. Includes SSO (Okta/SAML), SCIM, advanced RBAC, HIPAA-enabled workspaces, BAA available. Dedicated IPs $100/month per set.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Full compliance capabilities, contractual SLAs, dedicated support.

vendors.name: Railway
vendors.provenance: https://railway.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14; plan resource limits confirmed from https://docs.railway.com/reference/pricing/plans accessed 2026-06-14.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: Includes $5 of resource usage/month. Max 6 replicas per service, 48 GB RAM, 48 vCPU, 100 GB ephemeral storage. Usage beyond $5 credit billed at RAM $10/GB/month, CPU $20/vCPU/month, network egress $0.05/GB.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $20/seat/month. Includes $20 of resource usage per seat. Max 42 replicas, 1 TB RAM, 1,000 vCPU per service. Volume storage up to 1 TB. Annual committed spend discounts available (rate not published). Network egress $0.05/GB.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Contractual SLAs, SSO, dedicated support, procurement flexibility. Max 50 replicas, 2.4 TB RAM, 2,400 vCPU, 5 TB volume storage.

vendors.name: Fly.io
vendors.provenance: https://fly.io/docs/about/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. HIPAA add-on price $99/month confirmed from https://fly.io/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. Fly.io discontinued flat plans for new customers; all new accounts are pure pay-as-you-go. Legacy free allowances (3 shared-cpu-1x VMs, 3 GB volumes) still honored for pre-sunset Hobby/Launch/Scale plan holders only.

plans.name: Pay-as-You-Go (Shared CPU)
plans.notes: No flat tier for new accounts. Smallest published rate: shared-cpu-1x 256 MB ~$2.02/month (Amsterdam). shared-cpu-2x 512 MB ~$4.04/month. Performance-1x 2 GB ~$32.19/month. Volume storage $0.15/GB/month. Data egress North America/Europe $0.02/GB. Machine reservations available at 40% discount (e.g. $36/year for $5/month credit). Community support included free.

plans.name: HIPAA Compliance Add-on
plans.notes: $99/month add-on for HIPAA-compliant workloads. Includes BAA (one-click agreement). SOC 2 included. Added on top of compute/storage costs.

plans.name: Support Standard
plans.notes: Paid support tier. $29/month.

plans.name: Support Premium
plans.notes: Paid support tier. $199/month.

plans.name: Support Enterprise

plans.name: Hobby
